title: Multiple awards.
bodyText: The policy board may adopt rules authorizing the use and prescribing the manner in which goods, services, or construction may be procured through multiple awards.
bodyHtml: §103D-322  Multiple awards.  The policy board may adopt rules authorizing the use and prescribing the manner in which goods, services, or construction may be procured through multiple awards. [L Sp 1993, c 8, pt of §2; am L 1997, c 352, §23]
